# Rasa Sayang Automotive Group Sdn Bhd

> Hybrid, EV / new energy vehicle and supercar repair workshop in Shah Alam and Subang Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia. Company no. 202401033236 (1579084-X).

- Shah Alam HQ: 21, Jalan Serendah 26/40, Seksyen 26, 40400 Shah Alam, Selangor, Malaysia (Waze https://waze.com/ul/hw281pps03)
- Subang Jaya branch: 10, Jalan SS14/2, SS14, 47500 Subang Jaya, Selangor, Malaysia (Waze https://waze.com/ul/hw281rz2ue)
- WhatsApp and phone: +60 16-664 1686 (https://wa.me/60166641686)
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/rasasayangauto
- Makes serviced: BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Porsche, Lamborghini, Ferrari, McLaren, Volvo, Rolls-Royce, Audi, Land Rover
- Areas: Klang, Damansara, Cheras, Petaling Jaya, Puchong, USJ, Kuala Lumpur, Subang Jaya, Shah Alam
- Opening hours: not published; WhatsApp to arrange a time

## Services
- [Hybrid and EV repair](https://rasasayangautomotive.com/services/hybrid-ev-repair/): High-voltage battery, ERAD motor, onboard charger and module work.
- [Engine repair and overhaul](https://rasasayangautomotive.com/services/engine-repair-overhaul/): Engine repair, mounting, timing belt, gearbox and full overhaul.
- [Supercar repair](https://rasasayangautomotive.com/services/supercar-repair/): Lamborghini, Ferrari, McLaren, Porsche and Rolls-Royce.
- [Aircond repair](https://rasasayangautomotive.com/services/aircond-repair/): Compressor, condenser and cooling coil, hybrid systems included.
- [Support for other workshops](https://rasasayangautomotive.com/services/workshop-technical-support/): Complex faults, electronics and new energy vehicle repairs.

## Languages
English at the site root, Bahasa Melayu at /ms/, Simplified Chinese at /zh/. Every page exists in all three.
